en: Yesterday: a broken vase, heavy rain, and one liar.
Person 1 said: I was reading in the garden the whole time.
But it had been raining heavily since sunrise. All morning.
Nobody sits reading in a garden through heavy rain.
Three boxes. One has only apples, one has only oranges, and one has both.
Person 1 labelled them: Apples, Oranges, and Mixed.
But Person 1 got every single label wrong.
You may take out just one fruit, from just one box, without looking inside.
With that one fruit, you must fix all three labels.
So which box do you pick from?
Box 1, Apples. Box 2, Oranges. Or box 3, Mixed?
Comment 1, 2 or 3. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise.
